# Support

> English | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

## Where to ask for help

For reproducible defects, use the bug-report issue template. For documentation problems, use the documentation template. For a concrete enhancement, use the feature-request template.

Before opening an issue, include the smallest reproducible context you can provide: package/source version, Python version, host environment, backend, relevant Qdrant version, sanitized logs, and exact reproduction steps.

## What is not a public support request

Do not publish API keys, credentials, private model URLs, private dataset contents, or security vulnerabilities. Security-sensitive reports must follow `SECURITY.md` and be sent privately to `Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`.

The project does not currently promise paid support, response-time SLAs, or compatibility with every CPU host. The qualified performance and memory claims are limited to the documented qualification environment.
